description: 🚀 The easiest way to automate building and releasing your iOS and Android apps

latest_release.name: 2.242.0 Improvements
latest_release.body:
* [action][hockey] remove hockey action (#30604) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [fastlane] lanes --json: print only the JSON on stdout (#30601) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [spec] run supported_platforms and pricing_tier specs: name them *_spec.rb (#30599) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [action][typetalk] remove typetalk action (#30603) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [docs] Design.md: which route runs a command (#30593) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [frameit] skip ImageMagick passes that leave the image unchanged (#30598) via Wei-Lun Li (@b84330808)
* [fastlane_core] pkg_file_analyser spec: do not match xar's message (#30594) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [supply] force a track promotion (#22025) via João Felipe Santana (@jfelipe72)
* [spaceship] Fix merchant ID requests for macOS callers (#30378) via Augusto Xavier (@augustocbx)
* [spec] test_all_individually and rspec --bisect: run the repository's specs, without false failures (#30592) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [frameit] add iPhone Duo frame support (#30458) via Vlad (@brightsider)
* [fastlane_core] pkg_file_analyser: fail with xar's message when it cannot extract the pkg (#30557) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [snapshot] reset_simulators: delete nothing when simctl lists no runtimes or device types (#30556) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [action] swiftlint: fail with its message when `swiftlint version` fails (#30551) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [action] verify_pod_keys: fail with the message of a failed pod keys command (#30548) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [fastlane_core] zip_directory: fail when zip fails (#30547) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [gym] fail when the dSYM cannot be compressed (#30546) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [action] notarize: read notarytool's result past its log lines, and fail with its message (#30542) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [core][action][gym][spec] Stop modifying string literals (#30528) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* Bump github/codeql-action/upload-sarif from 4.39.2 to 4.39.3 (#30588) via dependabot[bot] (@dependabot[bot])
* Bump ruby/setup-ruby from 1.336.0 to 1.338.0 (#30587) via dependabot[bot] (@dependabot[bot])
* Bump addressable from 2.9.0 to 2.9.1 (#30589) via dependabot[bot] (@dependabot[bot])
* [ci] skip the Swift runner builds when the generated sources already passed (#30579) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [spaceship] App Store Connect API: raise the 401 and 403 errors when the body is not JSON (#30534) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [fastlane_core][fastlane] command execution: CommandExecutor.run, and chdir:/env:/stdin:/separate_stderr: for sh, run and execute (#30550) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* build: require mfa for rubygem accounts (#30584) via Connor Tumbleson (@iBotPeaches)
* Bump rack from 3.2.6 to 3.2.8 (#30582) via dependabot[bot] (@dependabot[bot])
* [action] mailgun: accept the deprecated :mailgun_sandbox_postmaster and :mailgun_apikey on their own (#30559) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [tests] spm-runner run.sh: reuse the installed gems when the bundle path is relative (#30577) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [ci] skip Swift package resolution when generate_swift_api builds the runner (#30578) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [ci] check the Swift runner the way fastlane builds it for users (#30576) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [tests] env guard: restore only the variables an example changed (#30575) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [ci] run RuboCop in parallel in lint_source (#30571) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [ci] time the --help check instead of running --help three more times (#30573) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [tests] plugin_generator_spec: run the generated plugin's rspec and rubocop once (#30574) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [spaceship] let the ConnectAPI User model load on its own (#30572) via Jerome Lacoste (@lacostej)
* [spaceship] Omit public link attributes for internal beta groups (#30567) via Eric Wu (@csc-EricWu)
